summary: Group brand launch briefing from Daniel Grellacott to firm leadership. Explains the common Tarnovell identity and group template, confirms that local scientific leadership and filing practices stay with each firm, and sets out how legacy client records will be handled. Dated February 2020.

properties.title: Tarnovell Bioscience Group: group brand launch
properties.subject: Group brand launch briefing

slides.title: Tarnovell Bioscience Group
slides.subtitle:
Group brand launch: briefing for firm leadership
Daniel Grellacott, Group Chief Executive
February 2020

slides.title: Why we are launching a common identity
bullets: The group has grown by acquisition since 1996 and each firm still carries the name it was bought under
Clients often meet two or three of our firms without knowing they belong to one group
The 2019 investment gives us a shared commercial plan, and it needs one face in the market
This briefing sets out what the launch changes, what it leaves alone and what we need from you before the rollout
slides.notes: Keep this section short. Most of the room will already have heard the investment story from Eleanor.

slides.title: What changes and what does not
bullets: Common group master template for proposals, reports and presentations under the 2020 launch
Shared Tarnovell wordmark and footer line on all external material
One group website entry point for enquiries, routed to the right firm
Group-level commercial reporting on a common calendar
bullets_right: Local scientific leadership stays with each firm's site head
Local accession and study numbering schemes are unchanged
Filing practices and document control stay as they are today
Existing firm names remain on contracts, invoices and regulatory correspondence

slides.title: The five firms joining the common identity in 2020
Local science stays local
bullets: Each firm keeps its own scientific leadership, study design and client relationships
Local scientific protocols and assay methods remain with each firm; presentation follows the common group master
Where a firm's scientists want to share method work across sites, the group will fund the time but not impose the approach
Site heads remain accountable for the quality of their own scientific output
slides.notes: Yasmin will follow up on quality system questions separately.

slides.title: Legacy client records
bullets: Records created before the 2020 group-template launch are not being restyled to the new template
Old proposals, reports and certificates keep their original brand and layout
Client contact details will be checked for changes of name only, not rewritten
Any document that is reissued after launch uses the new template, with the original reference retained

slides.title: Rollout timetable
bullets: February 2020: master template and brand guide issued to all five firms
February 2020: confirm local adoption of the group master introduced with the 2020 identity
March to April 2020: website entry point and enquiry routing tested with each firm
Spring 2020: firm-level brand reviews, with any exceptions agreed in writing with the group

slides.title: What we need from firm leadership
bullets: Nominate one person per firm to own the template and brand guide locally
Send any existing client-facing templates that carry a firm-specific layout by 28 February 2020
Tell us about any client contracts that name a firm in a way the launch could affect
Use the Tarnovell identity for new group-era communications; raise local template exceptions with head office

slides.title: Questions and contacts
bullets: Brand and template questions: Group Chief Executive's office at head office, Nottingham
Commercial reporting and calendar: Andrea Beckett, Group Finance Director
Quality system and document control: Yasmin Farhat, Group Quality Director
Please send questions by 14 February so we can answer them in the March update
